description.value: A cultural interpretive centre in Gitlaxt'aamiks (New Aiyansh), the capital of the Nisg̱a'a Nation, located 100 km northwest of Terrace on Highway 113. The centre showcases traditional artwork of the Gitmidiik (Grizzly Bear) clan, artifacts, displays, and audio-visual presentations on the history of the village, including a replica traditional smokehouse. It also features a restaurant with traditional and western cuisine, a gift shop, and a theatre.

Phone 250-633-3050 appears on the auto tour page. No evidence was found for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities. The restaurant is confirmed by the statement 'The centre features a restaurant which will include traditional and western cuisine.'
